name: Horizon for iOS (unofficial)
subtitle: Minecraft: Java Edition on iPhone, through Horizon
description: An unofficial port of Horizon, the Rust rewrite of Minecraft: Java Edition, to iPhone and iPad. It contains no Minecraft files: after you sign in with a Microsoft account that owns Java Edition, the app downloads your own copy from Mojang. Not affiliated with Horizon, Mojang or Microsoft.

apps.name: Horizon
apps.subtitle: Minecraft: Java Edition, unofficial port
apps.localizedDescription:
Horizon's own game client, built for iOS and drawn with Metal. Sign in with a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition and the app downloads the game files from Mojang (about 520 MB, once). Single player, servers, touch controls you can rearrange, and Simple Voice Chat.

Unofficial and experimental. Report bugs to @4rnz on Discord or on GitHub.

versions.localizedDescription: Render distance 32 no longer crashes; less battery per frame; one-tap updates with SideStore or AltStore.
59 native mods built in (off until turned on), Modrinth resource packs, the stretched picture fixed, and Edit HUD, loading screen and keyboard fixes.
Talk in Simple Voice Chat (VC, Talk and Mic buttons in Edit HUD), an update notice on the start screen, Extra Settings with Safe Area, and the chat above the keyboard.
No computer needed: the app downloads the game files itself after you sign in.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Horizon finds and joins worlds opened to the local network.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Horizon uses the microphone only for voice chat, when you turn it on.
